comparison.objective: PR-1151 purges air from a filled syringe while preserving liquid; the candidate adjusts mechanical gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1151 tests syringe orientation, fluid settling, gentle plunger control, and bimanual barrel stabilization, not driver/wrench torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1151 measures residual air, sample loss, safe return pose, release, and dwell; the candidate measures stop angle, nut retention, cycle repeatability, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The available versions consistently test fluid-preserving plunger control, which is unrelated to threaded stop calibration.
